purpose: Capture official SENAMHI meteorological avisos as reproduced by INDECI/COEN, with archived bytes, SHA-256, normalised fields, validity status in America/Lima and an append-only revision history. Feeds internal human review only.

source_channels.reason: The hosts decline automated access by the agent's web tools (robots). Automated requests are not routed around that refusal. Use requires an explicit owner decision backed by SENAMHI authorisation or a documented machine-access channel.

source_channels.note: INDECI/COEN publishes each SENAMHI aviso as a post in its 'emergencias' RSS feed (https://portal.indeci.gob.pe/emergencias/feed/): 'Boletín informativo de aviso meteorológico', 'Boletín informativo de aviso de corto plazo ante lluvias intensas' and '... ante posible activación de quebradas', plus the daily 'Monitoreo de peligros y perspectivas'. Posts and attached PDFs are archived with SHA-256. Field values are taken as reproduced by INDECI; SENAMHI emission time is recorded only when stated. portal.indeci.gob.pe has no robots.txt restriction (checked 2026-10-09).

cadence.idempotence: feed items are keyed by link and pubDate; unchanged items are not fetched again; documents are keyed by SHA-256
cadence.schedule_note: GitHub runs scheduled workflows only from the default branch: on this PR branch the capture runs on push and workflow_dispatch; the 30-min cron becomes active only if the owner merges. Runs may start late; each run is idempotent and reports minutes since the last success.

geometry.level_b_administrative: departments and provinces as listed in the bulletin table; boundaries not attached in v0.1

never: treat the download time as emission or validity
declare 'no avisos' after a failed check
mix the SENAMHI official level with an IRFEN review priority
publish to the map or to third parties
query SENAMHI hosts that decline automated access

bulletin_families.title_pattern: AVISO DE CORTO PLAZO ANTE LLUVIAS
AVISO DE CORTO PLAZO ANTE (POSIBLE )?ACTIVACION DE QUEBRADAS

products.ACP-LLUVIAS: Aviso de corto plazo ante lluvias intensas (24 h)
products.ACP-QUEBRADAS: Aviso de corto plazo ante posible activación de quebradas (24 h)

identity.number_source: 'Fuente: Aviso N° X ...' line of the INDECI bulletin (SENAMHI number); the INDECI bulletin number is kept separately as indeci_bulletin_id
identity.year_source: stated year when present, otherwise the year of the INDECI bulletin number (aviso_year_basis records which)
identity.observed_2026_10_09: SENAMHI rain aviso N°282 and quebradas aviso N°282 share the number but are distinct products; keying by number alone merges them

field_rules.official_level: only when the text states it (NIVEL ... ROJO/NARANJA/AMARILLO/VERDE). Short-term bulletins convey the level by map colour: left null with official_level_note; never inferred
field_rules.senamhi_emission: null unless stated; INDECI publication time (RSS pubDate) is kept as indeci_published_utc and is not the emission
field_rules.validity: VIGENCIA line as reproduced by INDECI (dd-mm-yyyy (hh:mm h) al ...), America/Lima; date-only -> whole days, noted
field_rules.departments_provinces: department/province table read from page-1 word coordinates; provinces left null when the grouping is ambiguous
field_rules.precipitation_mm: only when the text gives a mm figure
field_rules.geometry: level A not available from this channel; level B = administrative units as listed (representation, not footprint)

events.notification_channel: NOT_CONFIGURED: no external notification is sent
events.dedup: stable event_id = hash(event, aviso_key, revision, status, post, document); ids already seen are never re-emitted
